So 2^n - μ + sum P = 2^n - μ + 2^n - 1 = 2^{n+1} - 1 - μ = S_n - μ.

The claim is S_n - μ ≤ S_{n-1}, i.e., 2^{n+1} - 1 - μ ≤ 2^n - 1, i.e., μ ≥ 2^n.
